legal_framework.title: MAUCRSA statutory framework
legal_framework.citation: Business and Professions Code §§ 26000 et seq.
legal_framework.notes: Medicinal and Adult-Use Cannabis Regulation and Safety Act.

legal_framework.title: Testing requirement (statute)
legal_framework.notes: Requires laboratories to test cannabis goods for contaminants; authority cited by CCR §§ 15710–15728.

legal_framework.title: Required Testing
legal_framework.notes: Mandatory panel: cannabinoids, foreign material, heavy metals, microbial impurities, mycotoxins, moisture content and water activity, residual pesticides, residual solvents and processing chemicals, and terpenoids if applicable. Sample increments homogenized prior to analysis except foreign-material testing.

legal_framework.title: Laboratory Receipt of Samples
legal_framework.notes: Samples accepted only with chain-of-custody (COC); tamper-evident and commingling checks.

legal_framework.title: Validation of Test Methods
legal_framework.notes: FDA FVM guidelines; calibration curve r2 ≥ 0.99; certified reference material recovery 80–120%; validation reports to DCC.

legal_framework.title: Residual Solvents and Processing Chemicals Testing
legal_framework.notes: Minimum 0.25 g sample; report µg/g; Category I and Category II tables.

legal_framework.title: Residual Pesticides Testing
legal_framework.notes: Minimum 0.5 g sample; Category I reported at/above LOD, LOQ ≤ 0.10 µg/g; Category II reported in µg/g.

legal_framework.title: Foreign Material Testing
legal_framework.notes: Total representative sample tested prior to homogenization; interior + exterior of dried flower.

legal_framework.title: Cannabinoid Testing
legal_framework.notes: LOQ ≤ 1.0 mg/g for all reported cannabinoids; dry-weight conversion equation; total THC = (THCA × 0.877) + THC; ±10% label tolerance.

legal_framework.title: Terpenoid Testing
legal_framework.notes: Required only if requested; report % and mg/g (weight) or mg/mL (volume).

legal_framework.title: Certificate of Analysis
legal_framework.notes: 14 minimum COA items; 'Regulatory Compliance Testing' 14-pt header; ND / below-LOQ / NT conventions; COA to DCC within 1 business day (submission mailbox per § 15726; email omitted per privacy policy).

legal_framework.title: Remediation and Retesting
legal_framework.notes: A batch may only be remediated twice; after second failed retest the batch is destroyed.

legal_framework.title: Post Testing Sample Retention
legal_framework.notes: Reserve sample retained ≥ 45 business days; available to DCC on request.

legal_framework.title: Moisture Content and Water Activity Testing
legal_framework.notes: Dried flower incl. pre-rolls: water activity ≤ 0.65 Aw, moisture reported as %; solid edibles: water activity ≤ 0.85 Aw.

process_rules.rule: All batches of cannabis goods must be tested by a licensed laboratory before release for retail sale; a batch failing any required test shall not be released.
process_rules.citation: 4 CCR § 15714; §§ 15718–15724 (each panel ends with the release prohibition)

process_rules.rule: A batch additionally processed after failed testing must be retested and pass all required analyses. A batch may only be remediated twice; after the second failed retest the entire batch is destroyed.
Reserve sample retained at minimum 45 business days after analyses, stored to prohibit degradation/contamination/tampering, and provided to the Department on request.
COA generated for each representative sample; within 1 business day of completing analyses uploaded to track-and-trace and submitted to the Department's testing mailbox.

COA must contain 14 minimum items including lab identity + license, distributor/ cultivator/ manufacturer identity + licenses, batch number, sample identifiers, dates, sample picture, batch/sample weights or unit counts, density, methods + instrumentation + LOD/LOQ, LQC attestation, unknown/injurious analytes.

Overall pass/fail for the batch; qualitative pass/fail per analyte; quantitative results in required units; below-LOQ indicated as '<LOQ'; not detected or below-LOD indicated as 'ND'; unperformed tests indicated as 'NT'.
process_rules.notes: These are the official qualifier conventions; a parser must preserve them and never collapse ND/<LOQ to zero.

process_rules.rule: Methods validated per FDA guidelines; calibration r2 ≥ 0.99; certified reference material recovery 80–120%; validation reports signed and submitted to DCC within 5 business days of new/altered methods.
Samples accepted only with COC; tamper-evident seal must be intact; sample increments homogenized prior to analysis except foreign material testing.

Laboratories must hold a DCC testing laboratory license (CCR Title 4, Division 42, Chapter 5, §§ 15701–15705) and maintain ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation (SOPs associated with the accreditation certificate available for inspection).
process_rules.notes: ISO/IEC 17025 link is by § 15711(c) reference to the accreditation certificate SOPs; licensing chapter not re-transcribed this pass.

process_rules.rule: Any one cannabinoid, Total THC, and/or Total CBD claimed on a label is not inaccurate if the COA percentage differs by no more than ±10.0%.
Cannabinoid testing passes only if THC does not exceed the limits established in § 17304.
